column1: # Dane per-binary signing map (production, Developer ID, team MNL79V994R).
# Consumed by greatdane/tools/sign_dane_macos.py. Rows are signed TOP TO BOTTOM, inside-out, the app last.
#   glob         path inside Dane.app ("." = the app itself); fnmatch-style, no "**"
#   entitlements leaf name in security/mac/hardenedruntime/production/, or "-" for none (hardened runtime only)
#   need         required = at least one match must exist; optional = may be absent
# Every Mach-O under Contents/ must match exactly one row, or the tool refuses to sign.
# --- no entitlements: hardened runtime with defaults (same as Mozilla production) ---
# --- child processes with entitlements (Mozilla production files, unchanged) ---
# GMP process: loads Google-signed Widevine CDM and Cisco OpenH264 => needs disable-library-validation.
# Nightly-only (absent on ESR); listed so an unexpected copy is never signed with the wrong set.
